target_audience: Individuals and professionals in Douala, Cameroon. Mobile-first usage.
vibe: Warm, trustworthy, modern, culturally anchored (African accent) but highly professional.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-[#1A1A2E]
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#1A1A2E]
rules.labels: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-[#D4822A]

layouts.spacing: Generous padding: p-6 to p-12 on desktop, p-4 on mobile. Elements need breathing room.

grids.services: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6

layouts.header: Sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDF8F0]/90 border-b border-[#E5DCD0]/50
layouts.touch_targets: Minimum 48px height for all buttons and inputs on mobile.

surface_strategies.cards: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-[#E5DCD0]/60 shadow-sm transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-[#D4822A]/30
surface_strategies.inputs: bg-white border border-[#E5DCD0] rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D4822A]/20 focus:border-[#D4822A] transition-all
surface_strategies.buttons: rounded-full font-semibold transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2
surface_strategies.glassmorphism: Use for sticky header and floating WhatsApp button (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border border-white/20)

motion.entrance: staggered fade-in-up for service cards and list items
motion.micro: button scale down on click (active:scale-95), subtle icon translation on hover (group-hover:translate-x-1)

components_instructions.services_grid: Cards must be clickable, showing an icon (lucide-react), the service name, and a short description. Use a soft primary tint background on hover.
components_instructions.contact_form: Use Shadcn Form components (adapted for pure React/Tailwind if needed, without TSX). Must include fields: Nom, Téléphone/WhatsApp, Email, Domaine, Description, Quartier.
components_instructions.whatsapp_fab: Floating Action Button fixed at bottom-right. z-[60]. Color: #25D366. Needs a subtle pulse animation.
components_instructions.how_it_works: 3 steps (Search, Contact, Done) represented with large numeric indicators and clear icons.
components_instructions.admin_panel: Simple layout, dark sidebar (#1A1A2E), light content area (#FDF8F0). Use standard data tables with clear action buttons for managing domains and requests.
components_instructions.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons (tools, checkmarks, etc.).

hero_banner.description: Professional working on laptop, representing modern service providers.
hero_banner.usage: Hero section background or split-screen image. Ensure an overlay (bg-[#1A1A2E]/40) if text is on top.

how_it_works.description: Smiling African woman using a smartphone.
how_it_works.usage: Next to the 'How it works' steps to reinforce the mobile-first, easy booking experience.

about_us.description: People walking on the street in Douala, Cameroon during daytime.
about_us.usage: About Us section, establishing local roots and community connection in Douala.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on #D4822A buttons is #FFFFFF or #1A1A2E depending on APCA guidelines.
accessibility.focus: All focusable elements must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D4822A] focus:outline-none.
accessibility.aria: Add aria-labels to the WhatsApp floating button and icon-only buttons.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Files MUST be .js or .jsx, NOT .tsx or .ts. Do not use TypeScript syntax.
Mobile-first is critical: test all flex/grid layouts with mobile sizes first (e.g., flex-col by default, md:flex-row).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="service-card-plomberie"`, `data-testid="whatsapp-floating-btn"`).
NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds for the Header. Always use `backdrop-blur-md bg-[#FDF8F0]/90`.
DO NOT use generic centered text alignment globally (`.App { text-align: center; }`). Use left-alignment for body text and only center headers when intentional.
Avoid standard Vercel/Stripe stark black & white themes. Rely on the defined Warm African Color Palette (Ochre/Terracotta/Cream).
Use a structured component architecture: split UI into reusable pieces (e.g., ServiceCard, StepItem, ContactForm).
